Dear Major Gerrard: 


Sometime during April of this year it was reported 
in the press of Shanghai that the Customs on April 4th 
destroyed by burning a quantity of opium and other 
narcotics inoluding 145 catties of synthetio opium. 

This report has come to the attention of the Department 
of State which desires such information as may be avail- 
able concerning synthetic opium, particularly the compo- 
sition of this substance and the method, place ani extent 
of its manufacture. 


Any information which you can give me in this con-

be greatly appreciated.

S.B. D.1456

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & S. B. REGISTER
No. S. B. D. 1456.
Date 23 - 7 - 30.

July 22, 30.

Dear Mr. Cunningham,

Synthetic Opium.

In reply to your letter of July 17 on the
above subject, I have to inform you that the so
called synthetic opium was in reality a composition
of boiled pig skin and sesamum seed cake and has no
narcotic effect. It is frequently used for mixing
with inferior grades of opium for purposes of fraud
in opium transactions, and is in some instances
actually smoked by very poor addicts of the habit.

Opium, dross and ashes are also mixed with
this substance for fraudulent purposes to give it
the smell of opium whilst the colour is sometimes
obtained by mixture with date juice.

Without the opium or opium residue the
substance is manufactured locally in large quantities
for mixing with paint and varnish.

Yours sincerely,

(Sd) F. W. Gerrard

Edwin S. Cunningham Esq.,
U.S.A. Consul-General,
Shanghai.

上海公共租界工部局警务处
刑事与特别股登记簿
编号 S. B. D. 1456。
日期 30年7月23日。

1930年7月22日。

尊敬的坎宁安先生：

合成鸦片。

兹复阁下7月17日关于上述事由之来函，谨此奉告，所谓“合成鸦片”实为煮熟的猪皮与芝麻饼的混合物，并无麻醉功效。该物质常被掺入劣质鸦片中，用于鸦片交易中的欺诈行为；在某些情况下，极度贫困的瘾君子也会直接吸食此种物质。

出于欺诈目的，鸦片、烟膏及烟灰亦会混入该物质中，以赋予其鸦片的气味；而其颜色有时则通过掺入枣汁来获得。

若不添加鸦片或鸦片残留物，该物质会在本地大量生产，用于混合油漆和清漆。

此致

敬礼

（签名）F. W. Gerrard

埃德温·S·坎宁安 先生，
美国驻上海总领事，
上海。

致副总巡捕房长，（总务处）

现附上圣伊克林吉尔（St. Ickringill）就相关调查提交的报告。并不存在所谓的“合成鸦片”。李安托（Li-an-to）系由煮熟的罂粟壳与芝麻饼混合而成，常出于欺诈目的与劣质鸦片混合使用。此类“鸦片”被称为假冒或仿制鸦片。

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
File No. S. B. D. 1456.
Traffic Branch Station,
REPORT
Date July 22, 1900.
Subject (in full) Re Opium burned by the Maritime Customs.
Made by Sub-Inspr. C. P. Perkins. Forwarded by
Sir,
With reference to the attached letter, I
beg to report that I have made inquiries and
find that the opium in question which was
burned by the Customs on April 4th was not
synthetic opium but what is known as "Liao Ts"
(子料) or imitation opium. It is usually
composed of boiled pigs wind, sesamum seed
cake & when making imitation Indian Opium
sometimes dates are added to give the dark
rich colour.
I am, Sir,
Your obedient servant,
C. P. Perkins.
Sub-Inspector.
Officer i/c Traffic Branch.

上海公共租界工部局警务处。
档案号 S. B. D. 1456。
交通股警署，
报告
日期 1900年7月22日。
主题（全称） 关于海关焚烧鸦片事宜。
呈报人：副督察 C. P. Perkins。转呈人
阁下，

参照附件信函，卑职谨此报告，经查询得知，海关于4月4日焚烧的涉案鸦片并非合成鸦片，而是俗称的“料子”（子料）或仿制鸦片。其通常由煮熟的猪肠、芝麻饼组成；在制作仿制印度鸦片时，有时会加入枣子，以呈现深浓的色泽。

卑职谨呈，
阁下之恭顺仆人，
C. P. Perkins。
副督察。
交通股主管警官。

主题：海关焚烧的合成鸦片。

尊敬的杰拉德少校：

今年四月期间的某个时候，上海媒体报道称，海关于4月4日通过焚烧方式销毁了一批鸦片及其他麻醉品，其中包括145斤合成鸦片。此报道已引起美国国务院的关注，该局希望获取有关合成鸦片的现有资料，特别是该物质的成分，以及其制造方法、地点和规模。

如蒙阁下提供与此相关的任何信息，以便转呈国务院，将不胜感激。
